name: Charm Of Alraune
original_name: チャーム オブ アルラウネ
source:
The hero hears stories of men going missing in a forest near the village.
It seems some Alraune in the forest are the root of the problem,
so it's up to the hero to exterminate them.
But the battle goes in a strange direction...!?

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ302632.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
英雄听到有人在村庄附近的森林里失踪的故事。
看来森林里的一些阿尔劳恩才是问题的根源，
所以要由英雄来消灭他们。
但战斗却朝着奇怪的方向发展……！？

[来自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ302632.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite英语[/url]]
